context_requirements: DPEP1 expression is largely restricted to kidney, intestine and some tumors; most of the nine lines are not expected to express it at functionally relevant levels.
Even in DPEP1-expressing cells, the enzyme is a membrane dipeptidase whose inhibition is not known to feed into a transcriptional program within 6-24 h.
No direct transcriptional readout for DPEP1 inhibition has been established in these cell lines.
falsifiers: A reproducible, dose-dependent change in any landmark gene at 6 h or 24 h in multiple cell lines after 10 micromolar treatment.
Selective transcriptional response in a line known to express DPEP1 (e.g., a renal or intestinal line) but not in non-expressing lines.
Enrichment of a coherent pathway signature (e.g., glutathione or leukotriene metabolism) across lines.
